tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Never place body text directly on volt; place it on bg, surface or surface-raised.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Module cards, the day header and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything that floats above a surface: the Voice Dock, menus, the Change Receipt, inputs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows and around cards. Carries no meaning; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes). At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, timestamps and empty-state copy on bg, surface and surface-raised (6:1 or more).

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: The brand fill: primary buttons, the live microphone orb, today's bar in the Week Pulse. A fill only; text on it is on-volt.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a volt fill (17:1).

tokens.name: volt-ink
tokens.usage: Volt as text or a thin mark on bg, surface or surface-raised: links, active tab labels, the 'listening' caption. Darkens in Day so it stays above 5:1.

tokens.name: tone-blue
tokens.usage: Module tone: blue. The default colour of Agenda. Every module draws itself in one tone: its tag, its bars, its marks. Tones are text-safe on bg, surface and surface-raised (4.5:1 or more) and under text in the bg colour, and every pair of tones stays apart for people with red-green colour blindness (checked by scripts/tones.mjs).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and the day name on Today. Uppercase, font-stretch 125% (Archivo Expanded).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Workout titles, sheet titles. Sentence case, font-stretch 112%.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section card headers and list item titles that need weight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pádel con Marta en el club

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under an item, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase category tags, day initials in the Week Pulse, overlines.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Times, sets × reps, counters. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between Week Pulse bars, between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between section cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Section cards, inputs, list rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Voice Dock, sheets and the Change Receipt.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the microphone orb and Week Pulse bars.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for things that float over content: the Voice Dock and the Change Receipt.

tokens.name: glow-volt
tokens.usage: The halo around the microphone orb while listening. Pulses; never static decoration.

motion.rules: Movement springs; fades and colour use durations. Only transform, opacity and filter animate. With reduced motion, movement becomes a fade of at most duration-instant, or nothing. See docs/motion.md.

tempo.usage: The one dial for the whole app's pace. Every duration, every spring's response and the stagger step are multiplied by it at build time: 1.15 makes everything 15 % slower and calmer, 0.9 a tenth quicker. Loops keep their own rhythm. Change it, run pnpm tokens, look at /es/dev/motion.

easings.name: easing-standard
easings.usage: The default. Anything arriving or moving to a new place: entrances, glides, fills, fades and colour. Starts fast, lands softly.

easings.name: easing-emphasized
easings.usage: Small things that should feel alive as they appear or grow: Week Pulse bars, controls popping in. Overshoots a little.

easings.name: easing-exit
easings.usage: Things leaving: a sheet closing, a card dismissed. Starts slow and gets out of the way.

easings.name: easing-sway
easings.usage: Loops that go back and forth: listening bars, a breathing dot, the tremble while arranging.

durations.name: duration-instant
durations.usage: Press feedback and hover colour. Also the longest fade allowed with reduced motion.

durations.name: duration-base
durations.usage: Small movements: a bar growing, a card rising in, a tile settling.

durations.name: duration-slow
durations.usage: Larger movements: the Day Bar resizing, blocks gliding to a new place, a pressed box sinking.

durations.name: duration-glide
durations.usage: Progress: fills and numbers moving to a new value slowly enough to follow.

durations.name: duration-stagger
durations.usage: The step between things arriving one after another: the rows of a dialog, the controls of a card in edit mode.

springs.name: spring-snappy
springs.usage: Presses and toggles: quick, with almost no bounce.

springs.name: spring-smooth
springs.usage: Opening and closing details, moving between screens: no bounce at all.

springs.name: spring-bouncy
springs.usage: Things moved by hand: a card dropped into place, neighbours making room. Overshoots about 4 % and settles.

press.usage: How far a pressed control sinks. It scales so its edges move about `reach` pixels: small buttons go down to `deep`, wide cards stop at `shallow`. `dim` is the brightness it takes while held, the only change left with reduced motion. Press in over duration-instant, spring back on spring-snappy.
